claim_results.method: code review of the error paths in internal/example
claim_results.observed: the Update handler drops the store error and reports success
every transition has a defined from-state and rollback

findings.expected: Update propagates the store error and the caller sees a failure
findings.observed: Update returns nil after the store write fails; the caller proceeds as if the write succeeded

encounter.journey_summary: read Update -> call graph to store.Write -> error branch discards the result -> caller observes nil
encounter.last_good_checkpoint: store.Write returns a typed error for the duplicate key
encounter.wall_action: the error return value is assigned to _ at service.go:87
encounter.first_bad_checkpoint: Update returns nil although store.Write failed
encounter.terminal_state: caller commits the transaction and reports success

findings.visible_impact: callers persist partial state under a success signal
negative_facts: the sibling Delete path propagates errors correctly
open_questions: does any caller rely on the current drop behavior?
